versions.sourceProfile: Byte-oriented PHP source; zend.multibyte=0; short_open_tag enabled and disabled; lint acceptance, not runtime success.

code-unit.meaning: One raw source byte, including NUL.

non-ascii-code-unit.meaning: One raw byte in the range 0x80 through 0xFF.
non-ascii-code-unit.scannerContext: None; bytes, not Unicode code points.

html-code-unit.meaning: Byte in HTML state, stopping before the next enabled recognized opening tag.

line-comment-code-unit.meaning: Byte before CR, LF, EOF, or the first ?>.

block-comment-code-unit.meaning: Byte before the first */; never consume that terminator.

single-quoted-code-unit.meaning: Byte other than apostrophe or backslash inside a single-quoted string.

encapsed-code-unit.meaning: Text byte excluding the closing delimiter, backslash, and interpolation starts.
encapsed-code-unit.scannerContext: Active double-quote, backtick, or heredoc state and delimiter.

nowdoc-code-unit.meaning: Uninterpreted body byte before the matching closing label at a line start, respecting indentation.
nowdoc-code-unit.scannerContext: Nowdoc label, line position and indentation.
